content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197, prior auth missing at time of service. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer, so those avenues are closed. An appeal was already filed and failed. The service is not the patient's contractual responsibility since the provider failed to obtain required auth (provider write-off situation), and no further payer action can recover payment. This is a provider liability write-off.","action":"write_off"}
